entry.title: Nuremberg Castle

terrainReference.basis: Standard viewer PMTiles sample; reconstructed floors.

entry.note: The inspected aerial picture supports Sinwell's cylindrical body/capped roof, square towers, open court, red tiled roof groups and timber/plaster wings. Retained east/south map geometry sets approximate extent and orientation. Standard viewer PMTiles supply surrounding ground; the old study is translated-15m, lower reconstructed building/tower floors are raised only as needed above sampled coarse terrain, terrace toes reach it and the outer approach joins its sampled endpoint. Original detailed master remains preserved. Anchor 11.0753908,49.4580789; heading 0; standard PMTiles datum 337.1664037330291m. Floors are reconstructed and foundations extend below the coarse sampled ground. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
